newsitem.title: USA: Cellex Biosciences Q1 on target with plan.
newsitem.headline: Cellex Biosciences Q1 on target with plan.

text.p: Cellex Biosciences Inc, posting a loss of $0.24 a share for the December 31 first quarter on lower revenues, said Tuesday that results were as expected and on target with plans for the year.
Cellex, which provides cell processing products and services, said it did not expect a profit in the quarter.
"We continue to make good progress toward achieving sustainable quarter-to-quarter profitability," said president Richard Sakowicz in a statement.
"We are presently on target with plans necessary to achieve increased revenues, sustainable quarter-to-quarter profitability and positive cash flow," he added.
Sakowicz said among Cellex's fiscal 1997 plans are to:
--Improve gross margins and manufacturing efficiency through implementation of new material and manufacturing systems and process quality programs.
--Initiate production of the new Prelude benchtop stirred tank and fermentation systems.
--Complete the design, development and introduction of a new line of standard pilot plant and industrial scale fermentation and cell culture systems, scheduled for introduction in mid-1997.
